### Design Theory (2016–2023)
- Delivered semester-long courses on architectural and urban design paradigms  
- Emphasized theoretical frameworks and critical design thinking  
- Managed curriculum development, assessment design, and student evaluation aligned with Tribhuvan University standards  

### Design Studio (2016–2023)
- Independently taught undergraduate architecture studios across multiple levels  
- Guided students through site analysis, iterative design processes, and conceptual development  

### Human Settlement and Planning (2016–2023)
- Taught interdisciplinary approaches to human settlements  
- Focused on spatial planning, housing policy, and sustainable development strategies  
- Integrated Nepal’s institutional context with international planning frameworks
